longDescription: Marketing & ordering site for BikinBadjoe, a Bandung-based custom apparel brand — screen printing with no minimum order, a free design service, 150+ shirt colors, and an in-house convection since 2019.

title: Skincareku
description: An Indonesian-inspired skincare brand site — Nusantara ingredients, fully transparent labels, and a six-step ritual for tropical skin.
description_id: Situs brand skincare khas Indonesia — bahan Nusantara, label transparan sepenuhnya, dan ritual enam langkah untuk kulit tropis.
longDescription: Marketing & ordering site for Skincareku, a skincare brand built on traditional Nusantara ingredients — honey, rice, turmeric, coconut, and butterfly pea. Twelve formulas with complete, plain-language ingredient labels, a six-step ritual framework, and honest benefit descriptions (no "instant" or "permanent" claims), formulated for tropical climates.
longDescription_id: Situs marketing & pemesanan untuk Skincareku, brand skincare berbasis bahan tradisional Nusantara — madu, beras, kunyit, kelapa, dan bunga telang. Dua belas formula dengan label bahan yang lengkap dan mudah dibaca, kerangka ritual enam langkah, dan deskripsi manfaat yang jujur (tanpa klaim "instan" atau "permanen"), diformulasikan untuk iklim tropis.
highlights: Honest claims, made for tropical skin

title: LaundryKu
description: A pickup-and-delivery laundry service — signature wash packages, choose-your-fragrance care, and transparent upfront pricing per fabric type.
description_id: Layanan laundry antar-jemput — paket cuci pilihan, perawatan pilih-aroma-sendiri, dan harga transparan di depan sesuai jenis kain.
longDescription: Marketing & ordering site for LaundryKu, a pickup-and-delivery laundry with specialized garment care. Twelve signature wash packages and seven fragrance options, separate processing per customer, and pricing calculated upfront — from daily kilogram washing to dry cleaning for traditional fabrics and bridal wear.
longDescription_id: Situs marketing & pemesanan untuk LaundryKu, laundry antar-jemput dengan perawatan pakaian khusus. Dua belas paket cuci pilihan dan tujuh opsi aroma, pemrosesan terpisah per pelanggan, dan harga dihitung di depan — dari cuci kiloan harian sampai dry cleaning untuk kain tradisional dan busana pengantin.

title: Kainku
description: An Indonesian textile shop selling batik, tenun, songket & jumputan by the meter — detailed fabric specs, samples, and nationwide delivery.
description_id: Toko kain Indonesia yang menjual batik, tenun, songket & jumputan per meter — spesifikasi kain detail, sampel, dan pengiriman nasional.
longDescription: E-commerce site for Kainku, selling traditional Indonesian fabrics by the meter — batik, tenun, songket, and jumputan from regions across the country. Detailed specs per fabric (width, gsm, fiber, origin), 0.5-meter cutting increments, sample requests, and three visual perspectives per product.
longDescription_id: Situs e-commerce untuk Kainku, menjual kain tradisional Indonesia per meter — batik, tenun, songket, dan jumputan dari berbagai daerah. Spesifikasi detail per kain (lebar, gsm, serat, asal), potong per 0,5 meter, permintaan sampel, dan tiga perspektif visual per produk.

title: Pudingku
description: A handmade pudding & cake brand site — small-batch treats made fresh daily, no artificial flavors, cold-packed and made to order.
description_id: Situs brand puding & kue buatan tangan — camilan small-batch dibuat segar harian, tanpa perisa buatan, cold-pack dan sistem pre-order.
longDescription: Marketing & ordering site for Pudingku, a small-batch pudding and cake brand. Ten pudding varieties and six whole cakes made fresh daily with ingredients bought that day, no artificial flavors in fruit variants, cold-packed with production timestamps, and a made-to-order model with a replacement guarantee.
longDescription_id: Situs marketing & pemesanan untuk Pudingku, brand puding dan kue small-batch. Sepuluh varian puding dan enam kue utuh dibuat segar harian dengan bahan yang dibeli hari itu, tanpa perisa buatan pada varian buah, cold-pack dengan waktu produksi, dan sistem pre-order dengan garansi penggantian.
highlights: Made to order with replacement guarantee
